verdict.rationale: Reflect's own docs list native importers for Evernote (ENEX), Markdown files and Roam (JSON), plus Apple Notes and Workflowy, so three of the four named sources are covered. Notion is not listed, and nothing documents whether structure, links or attachments survive the import. missing for 10: Notion import, documented preservation of structure/hierarchy, links/backlinks and attachments on import, hands-on or independent corroboration of import fidelity.
